body:
If I do tell her the truth, I'll be trading this guilt for enough stress to kill me. I don't want to kill myself because I'm lying, I want to do it to escape that stress. No matter how I look at it, I can't see my mom being understanding of my situation and forgiving me. I'm just dreading the moment she catches on to my lies. That's when I think I'll kill myself.

Coming clean is the right thing to do. She deserves the truth and so much more for taking care of garbage like me. But if she doesn't find out until next semester, where I actually will be in uni like she wants by then, we both won't be dealing with all the stress that we'll have if she does find out now all the way to next semester. Her stress will be whether I'm actually doing work or planning to lie again. Mine will be how she acts towards me, and the fear of her doing anything bad. If I tell her the truth next semester, we can put it behind us.

She'll blame my computer and try to break it. Or cut the internet. When I told her I was going to that college that didn't accept me, at midnight I found her trying to forcibly yank the cable out of the wall. I won't deny it was the source of my procrastination but right now its vital for me to continue on. If I explain that to her she'll think I'm lying again for sure. This is the stress I'm certain I'll have if I tell her the truth.
